fusions.name: Straight-Line Sting
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles in a straight line onto the target and sting it for 12 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: All Hands Humming
fusions.desc: Your swarm stings every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%). Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Open Hatches
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm for 15 seconds. It stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Relief Rowers
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 20 seconds.
